title: Hydroformylation, hydroaminomethylation and related tandem reactions of bio-derived renewable olefins: a step closer to sustainability
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00662C, Critical Review
Open Access

Rupali S. Prajapati, Bhalchandra M. Bhanage
Biomass-derived renewable olefins act as sustainable and cost-effective starting materials in the production of industrially valuable chemicals, such as aldehydes, amines and other compounds, through hydroformylation and related one-pot reactions.
